name: Caps Lock Remap
author: Medal Huang
description: Pick what the Caps Lock key does from a bar menu: Control, Escape, Compose, plain Caps Lock, and more. Applies at once, without editing your Hyprland config.

barWidget.description: One click lists the Caps Lock mappings with a line on what each does. The choice applies at once, survives a restart, and never edits your Hyprland config.
